rationale: I read the complete held EO 9019 text (hash re-checked; acceptable_as_original true but an unverified OCR representation). It is a land-reservation order: sec.1 revokes EO 8578 in part, sec.2 modifies it, sec.3 withdraws and reserves new land, sec.4-5 set precedence and no-firing days, sec.6 states an intention to return the land when no longer needed, which is a statement of intent, not an own-terms end. The held evidence has no ACT:, TERM: end or ACTOR_TEXT: end for the whole order. EO 9526 (ACTOR_TEXT held and read) adds a jurisdiction-ceases-six-months-after-the-emergency paragraph but expressly keeps the lands withdrawn until otherwise ordered, so it is a partial amendment and its trigger event is not shown to have occurred. PLO 805 is revoked 'in part'; PLO 805, PLO 2613 are not held. The 1989 'public lands' row is only a lead. Cruden found no later held order citing EO 9019. No NO or YES basis exists, so no recommendation.
